info.name: FlashArray REST Active Directory Topology Groups API

params.name: context_names
params.description:
Performs the operation on the unique contexts specified.

If specified, each context name must be the name of an array in the same fleet or
the name of the fleet itself.

If not specified, the context will default to the array that received this request.

Other parameters provided with the request, such as names of volumes or snapshots,
are resolved relative to the provided `context`.

Enter multiple names in comma-separated format.
For example, `name01,name02`.

params.name: continuation_token
params.description:
A token used to retrieve the next page of data
with some consistency guaranteed.
The token is a Base64 encoded value.
Set `continuation_token` to the system-generated token taken from the `x-next-token`
header field of the response.
A query has reached its last page when the response does not include a token.
Pagination requires the `limit` and `continuation_token`
query parameters.

params.name: filter
params.description:
Narrows down the results to only the response objects
that satisfy the filter criteria.

params.name: ids
params.description:
A comma-separated list of resource IDs.
If after filtering, there is not at least one resource that matches
each of the elements of `ids`, then an error is returned.
This cannot be provided together with the `name` or `names` query parameters.

params.name: limit
params.description:
Limits the size of the response to the specified number of objects on each page.
To return the total number of resources, set `limit=0`.
The total number of resources is returned as a `total_item_count` value.
If the page size requested is larger than the system maximum limit,
the server returns the maximum limit, disregarding the requested page size.

params.name: list_all_parents
params.description:
When set to `true`, the results returned are expanded to also include all ancestors of every topology group matching
`names` or `ids`. This may only be specified if `names` or `ids` is also specified.
If not specified, defaults to `false`.

params.name: names
params.description:
Performs the operation on the unique names specified.
Enter multiple names in comma-separated format.
For example, `name01,name02`.

If there is not at least one resource that matches
each of the elements of `names`, then an error is returned,
except when creating new resources.

params.name: offset
params.description: The offset of the first resource to return from a collection.

params.name: sort
params.description:
Sort the response by the specified fields (in descending order if '-'
is appended to the field name).
NOTE: If you provide a sort you will not get a `continuation_token` in
the response.

params.name: total_item_count
params.description:
If set to `true`, the `total_item_count` matching the
specified query parameters is calculated and returned in
the response. If set to `false`, the `total_item_count`
is `null` in the response. This may speed up queries
where the `total_item_count` is large. If not specified,
defaults to `false`.

params.name: context_names
params.description:
Performs the operation on the context specified.

If specified, the context names must be an array of size 1, and the single element
must be the name of an array in the same fleet or the name of the fleet itself. If
not specified, the context will default to the array that received this request.

Other parameters provided with the request, such as names of volumes or snapshots,
are resolved relative to the provided `context`.

params.description:

Enter multiple names in comma-separated format.

If there is not at least one resource that matches

params.name: parent_topology_group_ids
params.description:
Assigns selected topology groups to the specified parent topology group by ID.
One of the `parent_topology_group_ids` or `parent_topology_group_names` parameters is required,
but they cannot be set together.

params.name: parent_topology_group_names
params.description:
Assigns selected topology groups to the specified parent topology group by name.
One of the `parent_topology_group_ids` or `parent_topology_group_names` parameters is required,
but they cannot be set together.

items.docs:
Creates topology groups. Provide `names` and optionally `parent_topology_group_names` or
`parent_topology_group_ids` selectors via query parameters.
